verdict.rationale: Helicone provides pieces needed for custom dashboards — HQL for custom queries, alerts on error rates/costs, real-time evaluation scoring for eval metrics, and explicit 'export to PostHog in one-line for custom dashboards' — but the evidence shows no native drag-and-drop dashboard builder unifying latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics in one view; custom dashboards are effectively delegated to an external tool (PostHog) or raw SQL/HQL queries. Missing for 10: first-party in-app custom dashboard builder, documentation showing latency/eval-score metrics combined with cost/error in a single customizable view, and independent user testimony of building such dashboards.
